etymologies.etymologyHTML: From motor +‎ cycle, from the Motorcyclette produced in 1897 by the French Werner Frères et Cie.

definitions.definition: An open-seated motor vehicle with handlebars instead of a steering wheel, and having two (or sometimes three) wheels.

quote.text: Vern rubbed her hands along the motorcycles, admiring their size and power, their silver and black sleekness.
